sources.snippet: This repository contains the code used for training and running visual document retrievers introduced by the ColPali: Efficient Document Retrieval with Vision Language Models paper. It includes the original ColPali model, based on the ColBERT architecture and the PaliGemma model, along with later ColVision and bi-encoder retriever variants.

sources.title: colpali-v1.2: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview colpali-v1.2 is a visual document retrieval model built on PaliGemma-3B that generates multi-vector embeddings using a ColBERT strategy to match document images with text queries. Created by vidore, this model ingests document images and text queries, processes them through patch embeddings from SigLIP, and generates interaction-based similarity scores for retrieval.
